about: Per ranked card and live class of docs/tst-openers.html: of the 5040 dealt orders of bag 2 (bag 1 on the board, the kind it left out in the hold, one hold slot), how many build a tiling of that class and fire the TST with bag-2 soft drops <= 0, 1, 2 and any (n), and per pair (A, B) of IJLOSTZ how many of the orders that build it at any cost deal A before B (pairs). Reproduces analysis/tst-openers-tp.json's cum at every class and budget with the board's bag-1 vector. w is that set (bit i = order i of the pairs' order table, little-endian, base64). plans holds per card a decision list over its live classes, best PC rate first: each step a class and rules (minimal conjunctions of at most 3 precedences 'A dealt before B') under which, among the orders some class builds and no earlier step decided, every order builds that class, each with how many such orders it hands the class; else the class every order still undecided builds; open the buildable orders no step decides; none the orders no class builds. no180 holds the same orders (n, w) and plans with the engine's 180 rotation removed for every bag-2 piece (bag 1 stands on the board as before); its orders are a subset of the 180 ones and never cheaper.
